response: There is a knowledge deficit regarding the target serum urate (SU) treatment goal among gout patients receiving urate-lowering therapy (ULT). Despite having a generally high level of other gout-specific knowledge, many gout patients are not aware of their target serum urate goal. This lack of awareness suggests that healthcare providers may not be effectively communicating this important information to their patients, highlighting the need for improved education and communication about serum urate goals in the management of gout.
